filters_flows_previewing: Previewing the effect of this change…
filters_flows_row_stored: Stored torrents no longer hidden, demoted or flagged
filters_flows_row_core_caught_30d: Caught by the child-safety core in the last 30 days
filters_flows_estimate_note: Estimated from torrent names only: file lists aren't kept, so their files weren't checked again.
filters_flows_error_empty: Enter your password to apply this change.
filters_flows_error_bad_password: That password is wrong. Enter it again.
filters_flows_error_rate_limited: Too many password attempts. Wait before trying again.
filters_flows_changed: The effect changed. Read the warning again.
filters_flows_busy: Already applying: wait for the result.
filters_flows_shadow_note: Shadow mode: for {days} days this only records what it would do. Nothing changes yet.
filters_flows_error_network: Lodestar isn't responding. Check that it's running, then try again.
filters_flows_error_code: Lodestar refused the change ({code}). Check the change and try again; if it keeps happening, check Lodestar's log.
filters_flows_adult_body: Adult torrents will appear in Search, Discover, Alerts and Insights. Torznab, Stremio and export keep their own adult settings, which stay off until you turn them on.
filters_flows_adult_age: Turn this on only if you're 18 or older.
filters_flows_adult_env: Set by {variable}; change it in the container template.
filters_flows_adult_refused: Lodestar didn't accept the confirmation. Try again.
filters_flows_hashes_help: One or more, 40 hex digits each, separated by spaces, commas or new lines. Only these torrents match, never renamed reposts.
filters_flows_query_help: Any search query, such as a title, an uploader or a release group.
filters_flows_strength_override_help: Skips every core rule except the locked floor, plus the rule packs and your rules.
filters_flows_strength_neutralize_help: The word stops counting as evidence; everything else in the torrent still counts.
filters_flows_scope_help: A query that limits the entry, such as type:adult.
filters_flows_shadow_days_help: Records what it would release without releasing anything.
filters_flows_invalid_hashes: Each info hash is 40 hex digits.
filters_flows_invalid_payload: A payload signature is 16 hex digits.
filters_flows_invalid_days: Enter a whole number of days, from 1 to {max}.
filters_flows_block_lead: Start with the narrowest rule. A word from the name can catch far more than this torrent.
filters_flows_tier_torrent_help: Only this torrent's own info hashes.
filters_flows_reason_no_payload_signatur: Not available yet: torrents don't carry a payload signature here.
filters_flows_reason_no_group: Not available yet: torrents don't name an uploader or release group here.
filters_flows_phrase_help: Pick consecutive words. The rule matches names that contain them in this order.
filters_flows_phrase_invalid: Pick at least one word, 200 bytes at most.
filters_flows_action_hide_help: Kept but hidden from search, including torrents already stored. Undo it at any time.
filters_flows_action_quarantine_help: Held out of the index with the name sealed, and purged after 30 days unless released.
filters_flows_action_drop_help: Never stored or fetched again. Torrents already stored stay as they are.
filters_flows_reveal_lead: The name is shown here only, until you close this dialog. It isn't copied, saved or logged.
filters_flows_reason_bad_hash: Not available: this torrent's info hash isn't valid.
filters_purpose: Choose what Lodestar holds back, hides or lets through. Every change is previewed first.
filters_load_failed: Filters couldn't be loaded. Nothing was changed.
filters_part_failed: Part of this page couldn't load.
filters_dialog_failed: The change dialog couldn't load, so nothing was changed.
filters_core_help: These rules are always checked. Rules marked Locked can't be turned off.
filters_cs1_count: {count} entries in the child-abuse hash list.
filters_pending_help: A list or file stopped naming these entries. They stay blocked until you decide.
filters_pending_remove_title: Remove these entries from the floor
filters_overrides_help: Entries here let matching torrents past filters. Each one shows a warning and asks for your password.
filters_exceptions_help: Torrents released from one rule. Add them from the review queue with False positive.
filters_allow_help: Torrents matching these searches skip your rules. This loosens filtering, so it asks for your password.
filters_undo_help: Go back to the rule set before your last change. It can loosen filtering, so it may ask for your password.
filters_queue_help: Torrents the filters are holding, shown by hash only. A name can be revealed one at a time, with your password.
filters_queue_failed: The review queue couldn't be loaded.
